mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to reduced corporate revenue expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a contraction in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of corporate earnings deterioration and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising above 3.0% annually, it indicates a tightening monetary regime that increases real borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction starts (HOUST) above 1050 thousand units, combined with a rise in consumer spending (RSAFS), signals a recovery in private demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1050 and RSAFS > 430000 fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 in a single month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter, combined with a decline in industrial production, signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0% in last quarter AND INDPRO decline in last 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal of negative GDPC1 growth and declining INDPRO fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).
